from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
captions = ['Studies of Flavonoids and Cardiovascular Outcomes', 'High-linoleic acid diet, high-stearic acid diet, high trans fatty acid diet', 'Composition (%) of Vagetable Oils and Animal Fats', 'Concentrations of serum total and HDL cholesterol', 'Chocolate and Cocoa Feeding Trials', 'Assayed macronutrient composition of experimental diets']
vec = TfidfVectorizer(stop_words='english')
X = vec.fit_transform(captions)
km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0)
labels = km.fit_predict(X)
print("Cluster labels:", labels)
# Map clusters to arbitrary reference number seeds
seed_map = {0:4, 1:21, 2:13}
assigned = [seed_map[l] for l in labels]
print("Assigned seeds:", assigned)
